name: invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || patient as name, ref from v_invoices where status in ('sent', 'paid')

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.ref as invoice, p.name as billed_to, i.payer, to_char(i.issued_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as issued, to_char(i.due_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as due, coalesce(c.ref || ': ' || c.title, '') as case, coalesce(c.claim_number, '') as claim from invoices i join patients p on p.id = i.patient_id left join cases c on c.id = i.case_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Items
sections.sql: select description, qty, round(unit_cents / 100.0, 2) as unit, round(qty * unit_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount from invoice_items where invoice_id = $1

sections.title: Payments and balance
sections.sql: select round(total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total, round(paid_cents / 100.0, 2) as paid, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as balance, initcap(status) as status from v_invoices where id = $1

name: patient-statement
title: Statement
for_each: select p.id, p.name from patients p where exists (select 1 from v_invoices i where i.patient_id = p.id and i.balance_cents > 0 and i.status = 'sent')

sections.title: Open invoices
sections.sql: select ref as invoice, to_char(issued_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as issued, to_char(due_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as due, payer, round(total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing from v_invoices where patient_id = $1 and balance_cents > 0 and status = 'sent' order by issued_on

sections.title: Total owing
sections.sql: select round(sum(balance_cents) / 100.0, 2) as amount_due from v_invoices where patient_id = $1 and balance_cents > 0 and status = 'sent'

name: case-summary
title: Episode of care summary
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || patient as name from v_cases where status = 'open'

sections.title: The case
sections.sql: select c.ref, p.name as patient, c.title as condition, c.funding || coalesce(' ' || c.claim_number, '') as funding, to_char(c.opened_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as opened, coalesce(r.name, '') as referrer, case when c.approved_sessions is null then null else c.approved_sessions end as approved_sessions from cases c join patients p on p.id = c.patient_id left join referrers r on r.id = c.referrer_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Visits
sections.sql: select to_char(a.on_date, 'DD Mon YYYY') as date, s.name as service, pr.name as practitioner, a.status, coalesce(tn.status, '') as note from appointments a join services s on s.id = a.service_id join practitioners pr on pr.id = a.practitioner_id left join treatment_notes tn on tn.appointment_id = a.id where a.case_id = $1 order by a.on_date

sections.title: Latest finalised note
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'DD Mon YYYY') as date, subjective, objective, assessment, plan from treatment_notes where case_id = $1 and status = 'final' order by on_date desc limit 1

name: progress-report
title: Progress report
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || patient as name from v_plans where status = 'active'

sections.title: The patient and the case
sections.sql: select tp.ref as plan, p.name as patient, c.ref as case, c.title as condition, c.funding || coalesce(' ' || c.claim_number, '') as funding, coalesce(pr.name, '') as practitioner from treatment_plans tp join patients p on p.id = tp.patient_id join cases c on c.id = tp.case_id left join practitioners pr on pr.id = tp.practitioner_id where tp.id = $1

sections.title: Goal and progress
sections.sql: select goal, measure, baseline, latest_score as latest, target as goal_score, coalesce(progress_pct || '%', '') as progress, sessions_done || ' of ' || planned_sessions as sessions from v_plans where id = $1

sections.title: Outcome scores
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'DD Mon YYYY') as date, score, coalesce(note, '') as note from outcome_scores where plan_id = $1 order by on_date
